meta.title: Improve Racket backend runtime helper selection
meta.body_summary: Split Racket runtime helpers into individual constants, track used helpers during compilation, and emit only those, reducing runtime overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Author merged self-authored Codex PR with no review; small change to Racket backend to emit only needed runtime helpers based on usage tracking.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 120 changed lines in 2 files, this is a small change by absolute volume. It fits a compact compiler optimization PR and was merged rapidly without review, consistent with low-risk self-merge pattern.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/racket, split runtime helper code into individual constants (runtime.go) and track which helpers are actually used during compilation (compiler.go), emitting only the needed helpers instead of all.
change_trajectory: Single commit (299e5312) adds runtime helper tracking logic and splits helpers into separate constants.
